metadataRaw.title: How to Relieve WRIST PAIN in Seconds
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates simple exercises that may help ease wrist pain in as little as 30 seconds.

They’re great to use throughout the day to relieve wrist aches, stiffness, and tightness — and may also help reduce numbness or tingling associated with carpal tunnel syndrome.

Each exercise targets the wrist in a different way. For best results, try them all and continue with the ones that give you the most relief.

Watch now and start relieving wrist pain at home!

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:30 Wrist Bends
1:42 Muscle Scraping (Gua Sha)
5:42 Desk Stretch
6:54 Desk Stretch (Advanced)
8:06 Prayer Stretch
9:22 Piano Fingers
